flags.message: Forward-mode disclosure: the live docket page (supremecourt.gov, fetched 2026-09-27) shows two entries after my arrival-position baseline: a response requested by Justice Sotomayor on 2026-09-23 (due 2026-09-28) and a Becket Fund amicus brief submitted 2026-09-25. I stated the response-requested and amicus increments at 0.97 on that basis, so those two claims carry no forecast content for this cell. No disposition had been entered.

The WebSearch tool's machine-generated summary claimed the application was granted on August 24, 2026 with dissents by Justices Sotomayor, Kagan and Jackson. That date precedes the application's own filing (2026-09-17) and the authoritative docket page shows it pending, so I treated the statement as fabricated and did not use it. Flagged so the evaluator can see the stray claim in the transcript was rejected rather than folded in.

fedcourts corpus-info raised an exception in this cell (no local corpus blob; read-only connect failed), so no corpus vintage could be quoted for the fedcourts query priors. The query itself worked through the corpus service.
